messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Ibuprofen is used in adults and children. Some formulations are also used in premature babies to close a certain heart defect.

C. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
